intro: Carmilla (カーミラ Kāmira?) is the second main antagonist of the Castlevania animated series. She is the vampiress Queen of Styria, as well as the leader of the Council of Sisters. She is a scheming and manipulative noblewoman, and former ally and general of Lord Dracula, who sought to usurp control over the vampires from him and raise them as the world's new dominant species.
appearance:
Carmilla bears the appearance of an elegant and majestic pale woman with crimson red lips, icy blue eyes, and long straight white hair. Although her face is mostly round, she has a notoriously pointy chin, which could likely be a reference to her mask initially seen in Castlevania II: Simon's Quest. She is also seen wearing a black and crimson red ombre dress, sporting golden shoulder plates and matching heels. While in Styria, Carmilla always dons several long, elegant blood-red dresses with golden accessories and heels. Her nightgown had an open cleavage with a single button below the chest and golden, rounded shoulder pads.

Appearance
Carmilla is a tall, slender and beautiful female Vampire with pale gray skin, crimson lips, icy blue eyes, and long, straight white hair. Although her face is mostly round, she has a rather pointy chin. She also has long, sharp, claw-like fingernails.
Carmilla always wears long, elegant, form-fitting dresses. She is first seen wearing a black and crimson red ombre dress, sporting golden shoulder plates and matching heels. While in Styria, Carmilla dons several long, elegant blood-red dresses with golden accessories and heels. Her red nightgown has an open cleavage with a single button below the chest and golden, rounded shoulder pads.
